<content>
1: # PLAN_V1.md — Reflex.md v1 Execution Plan
2: 
3: > **Goal:** ship a working end-to-end demo of Reflex.md. Connect GitHub → parse `entire/checkpoints/v1` → detect repeated corrections → open a PR against `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`.
4: >
5: > **Locked decisions** (from planning):
6: > - Landing page copies **devlog** aesthetic verbatim (neon green `#00ff41` on zinc-950, JetBrains Mono + Space Grotesk).
7: > - Dashboard uses **shadcn/ui** themed against Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens shared with the landing page.
8: > - LLM is **Gemini** via `@google/genai`. Primary slug `gemini-3.1-flash` currently 404s — **live flow runs on `gemini-2.5-flash`** (verified via `scripts/gemini-smoke.ts`).
9: > - Frontend on `:3000`, backend on `:3001`, Postgres on `:5432`.
10: > - GitHub OAuth App (not App). Homepage `http://localhost:3000`, Callback `http://localhost:3001/auth/github/callback`.
11: 
12: ---
13: 
14: ## 0. Stack
15: 
16: | Layer | Choice |
17: |---|---|
18: | DB | Postgres 16 (docker) |
19: | ORM | Prisma |
20: | Backend | Node 20 + TS + Express |
21: | Frontend | Vite + React 19 + TS + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui |
22: | Diff viewer | `@monaco-editor/react` DiffEditor |
23: | Git | `simple-git` |
24: | GitHub API | `@octokit/rest` |
25: | Auth | GitHub OAuth (user token) + JWT cookie |
26: | LLM | `@google/genai` — `gemini-3.1-flash` |
27: | Queue | None (synchronous) |
28: 
29: ---
30: 
31: ## 1. Folder layout
32: 
33: ```
34: web/
35: ├── PLAN_V1.md
36: ├── docker-compose.yml
37: ├── .env.example / .env
38: ├── brand/                         ← reference docs
39: ├── backend/
40: │   ├── package.json
41: │   ├── tsconfig.json
42: │   ├── prisma/schema.prisma
43: │   ├── scripts/smoke.sh
44: │   ├── test/
45: │   │   ├── parser.test.ts
46: │   │   └── fixtures/checkpoint-barrel/…
47: │   └── src/
48: │       ├── server.ts
49: │       ├── prisma.ts
50: │       ├── auth.ts
51: │       ├── parser.ts
52: │       ├── ingest.ts
53: │       ├── friction.ts
54: │       ├── llm.ts
55: │       ├── analyze.ts
56: │       ├── github.ts
57: │       └── types.ts
58: └── frontend/
59:     ├── package.json
60:     ├── vite.config.ts               ← port 3000, proxy /api + /auth
61:     ├── index.html
62:     ├── components.json
63:     └── src/
64:         ├── main.tsx / App.tsx
65:         ├── index.css                ← Tailwind v4 + @theme (ported from devlog)
66:         ├── api.ts
67:         ├── lib/utils.ts
68:         ├── components/
69:         │   ├── ui/                  ← shadcn primitives
70:         │   ├── landing/             ← Navbar, Hero, TerminalDemo, Features, Marquee, CTA, Footer
71:         │   └── dashboard/           ← SessionRow, Timeline, FrictionReport, DiffView, OpenPrDialog
72:         └── pages/
73:             ├── Landing.tsx          ← `/`
74:             ├── Repos.tsx            ← `/repos`
75:             └── Repo.tsx             ← `/repos/:owner/:name`
76: ```
77: 
78: ---
79: 
80: ## 2. Data model
81: 
82: 4 tables — `User`, `Repo`, `Session`, `Analysis`. Events live as JSON on `Session.events`.
83: 
84: ```prisma
85: model User {
86:   id          String   @id @default(cuid())
87:   githubLogin String   @unique
88:   accessToken String
89:   createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
90:   repos       Repo[]
91: }
92: 
93: model Repo {
94:   id            String    @id @default(cuid())
95:   userId        String
96:   user          User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
97:   owner         String
98:   name          String
99:   defaultBranch String    @default("main")
100:   sessions      Session[]
101:   analyses      Analysis[]
102:   @@unique([userId, owner, name])
103: }
104: 
105: model Session {
106:   id            String    @id @default(cuid())
107:   repoId        String
108:   repo          Repo      @relation(fields: [repoId], references: [id])
109:   checkpointId  String
110:   idx           Int
111:   strategy      String
112:   branch        String?
113:   startedAt     DateTime
114:   endedAt       DateTime?
115:   filesTouched  String[]
116:   tokenUsage    Json
117:   events        Json
118:   frictionScore Float     @default(0)
119:   @@unique([repoId, checkpointId, idx])
120: }
121: 
122: model Analysis {
123:   id            String   @id @default(cuid())
124:   repoId        String
125:   repo          Repo     @relation(fields: [repoId], references: [id])
126:   createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
127:   frictionScore Float
128:   targetFile    String
129:   beforeText    String   @db.Text
130:   afterText     String   @db.Text
131:   unifiedDiff   String   @db.Text
132:   reasoning     Json
133:   clusters      Json
134:   prNumber      Int?
135:   prUrl         String?
136: }
137: ```
138: 
139: ---
140: 
141: ## 3. API surface (8 endpoints)
142: 
143: | Method | Path | Purpose |
144: |---|---|---|
145: | GET  | `/auth/github`          | Redirect to GitHub authorize |
146: | GET  | `/auth/github/callback` | Exchange code → JWT cookie → redirect `/repos` |
147: | POST | `/auth/logout`          | Clear cookie |
148: | GET  | `/api/me`               | Current user |
149: | GET  | `/api/repos`            | List user's GitHub repos |
150: | POST | `/api/repos/:owner/:name/ingest`  | Clone shadow branch, parse, upsert, return sessions |
151: | POST | `/api/repos/:owner/:name/analyze` | Friction + Gemini, return Analysis + clusters |
152: | POST | `/api/analyses/:id/open-pr`       | Create branch + PR, return `{prUrl, prNumber}` |
153: 
154: ---
155: 
156: ## 4. Theme (Tailwind v4 `@theme` ported from devlog)
157: 
158: - Tokens identical to devlog: `--color-green: #00ff41`, `--color-bg-primary: #0a0a0a`, `--color-bg-card: #111111`, etc.
159: - shadcn CSS-var bridge added inside the same `@theme` block so shadcn primitives inherit the devlog palette without forking components.
160: - Fonts: `JetBrains Mono` (mono) + `Space Grotesk` (display).
161: - Utilities ported: `btn-clip`, `hero-glow`. Keyframes: `pulse-dot`, `blink`, `marquee`.
162: 
163: ---
164: 
165: ## 5. Friction detection
166: 
167: - `detectCorrections(events)` — flags `user_prompt` matching negation regex (intensity 1) and `tool_call` with non-zero exit followed by same `tool_name` within 60s (intensity 2).
168: - `scoreSession(events)` — `Σ intensity / max(prompts, 1)`. Thresholds per `brand/METRICS.md`: `<0.3` green, `<0.8` amber, `≥0.8` red.
169: - `clusterCorrections(all)` — stopword-filter then sort+join first 5 tokens as cluster key. Return top 5 with count and up to 3 sample texts.
170: 
171: ---
172: 
173: ## 6. Gemini adapter
174: 
175: ```ts
176: import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
177: const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY! });
178: 
179: const models = ["gemini-3.1-flash", "gemini-2.5-flash"];
180: for (const m of models) {
181:   try {
182:     return await ai.models.generateContent({
183:       model: m,
184:       config: {
185:         systemInstruction: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
186:         responseMimeType: "application/json",
187:         responseSchema: OUTPUT_SCHEMA,
188:       },
189:       contents: userPrompt,
190:     });
191:   } catch (e) { continue; }
192: }
193: ```
194: 
195: System prompt per `brand/ANALYSIS_ENGINE.md`: never touch source; every rule cites a checkpointId; prefer rewriting existing rules over adding new ones.
196: 
197: ---
198: 
199: ## 7. Hour-by-hour
200: 
201: | Window | Task |
202: |---|---|
203: | 0:00–0:15 | Scaffold backend & frontend, docker compose up, kill stale :3000 |
204: | 0:15–0:25 | Prisma schema + `migrate dev`, `.env` populated |
205: | 0:25–0:55 | Parser + Vitest + fabricated fixtures |
206: | 0:55–1:15 | Push fixtures to `<you>/reflex-demo` on `entire/checkpoints/v1` |
207: | 1:15–1:40 | OAuth, `/api/me`, `/api/repos` |
208: | 1:40–2:05 | Ingest endpoint |
209: | 2:05–2:25 | Friction + Gemini + `/analyze` |
210: | 2:25–2:50 | Landing port from devlog (Reflex copy) |
211: | 2:50–3:15 | Dashboard shell (Repos + Repo 3-panel) |
212: | 3:15–3:35 | FrictionReport + DiffView |
213: | 3:35–3:50 | Open PR endpoint + dialog |
214: | 3:50–4:00 | Manual test run + record |
215: 
216: ---
217: 
218: ## 8. Cut list (in order)
219: 
220: 1. FrictionReport panel
221: 2. Reasoning list under diff
222: 3. Terminal demo animation on landing
223: 4. Marquee
224: 5. shadcn polish (raw Tailwind using same tokens)
225: 6. Landing entirely — redirect `/` to `/auth/github`
226: 
227: ---
228: 
229: ## 9. Automated tests
230: 
231: - `backend/test/parser.test.ts` (Vitest) — asserts checkpoint ID, session count, event parsing, tolerates malformed JSONL line.
232: - `backend/scripts/smoke.sh` — `/api/health` 200, `/api/me` 401 without cookie.
233: 
234: ## 10. Manual test checklist
235: 
236: ### A. Setup
237: - [ ] `docker compose up -d` → Postgres healthy on `:5432`
238: - [ ] `pnpm --filter backend dev` logs `api on 3001`
239: - [ ] `pnpm --filter frontend dev` logs `Local: http://localhost:3000`
240: - [ ] `/api/health` returns `{ ok: true }`
241: 
242: ### B. Landing
243: - [ ] Hero renders with green glow + pulse-dot status
244: - [ ] Terminal demo shows blinking cursor
245: - [ ] Features grid: 4 cards, hover raises green shadow
246: - [ ] Marquee scrolls; pauses on hover
247: - [ ] No console errors
248: 
249: ### C. Auth
250: - [ ] "Install on GitHub" → redirects to GitHub authorize
251: - [ ] Authorize → lands on `/repos` with session cookie set (httpOnly)
252: - [ ] `/api/me` returns your login
253: - [ ] Incognito `/api/me` → 401
254: - [ ] `/auth/logout` clears cookie
255: 
256: ### D. Repo picker
257: - [ ] `/repos` shows shadcn card grid
258: - [ ] Demo repo appears with pushed-at + private badge
259: - [ ] Click repo → `/repos/:owner/:name`
260: 
261: ### E. Ingest
262: - [ ] Ingest auto-fires on first visit (or click button)
263: - [ ] Skeleton shows for 5–30s
264: - [ ] Left timeline lists 3 sessions, newest first
265: - [ ] Strategy badge, time, FQ badge per row
266: - [ ] ≥2 of 3 sessions show amber/red FQ
267: - [ ] Re-running doesn't duplicate rows
268: - [ ] Repo without shadow branch → friendly error
269: 
270: ### F. Analyze
271: - [ ] Click Analyze → loading state
272: - [ ] Within ~15s, FrictionReport shows ≥1 cluster referencing barrel/exports
273: - [ ] DiffView renders side-by-side diff on AGENTS.md
274: - [ ] Proposed addition mentions barrel exports
275: - [ ] Reasoning cites ≥1 checkpoint ID present in timeline
276: - [ ] Re-clicking Analyze creates new Analysis row
277: 
278: ### G. Open PR
279: - [ ] Click Open PR → dialog appears
280: - [ ] Within ~5s dialog shows success state with PR URL
281: - [ ] URL opens GitHub PR
282: - [ ] PR body has friction score, Why section, samples, checkpoint IDs
283: - [ ] PR diff matches Monaco view
284: - [ ] Branch named `reflex/update-AGENTS-md-<8char>`
285: - [ ] Re-clicking Open PR returns existing PR (no duplicate)
286: 
287: ### H. Failure modes
288: - [ ] Gemini missing key → toast error, no crash
289: - [ ] No push access → readable error
290: - [ ] Backend down → skeletons then error state
291: - [ ] Hard refresh on `/repos/:o/:n` restores state
292: 
293: ### I. Visual parity
294: - [ ] Green `#00ff41` consistent across landing and dashboard
295: - [ ] JetBrains Mono + Space Grotesk loaded
296: - [ ] `btn-clip` clip-path renders
297: - [ ] Scrollbar green-on-black
298: 
299: ---
300: 
301: ## 11. Risks
302: 
303: | Risk | Mitigation |
304: |---|---|
305: | Gemini model slug unrecognized | Try `gemini-3.1-flash` first, fall back to `gemini-2.5-flash`. Log active model. |
306: | Port 3000 busy | `lsof -ti:3000 \| xargs kill -9` in dev script. |
307: | shadcn vs devlog token clash | CSS-var bridge inside `@theme` — test `<Button>` rendering. |
308: | Parser breaks on unexpected JSONL | Per-line try/catch; skip malformed lines. Vitest covers it. |
309: | OAuth redirect loop | Verify callback matches exactly. Test in incognito. |
310: 
311: ---
312: 
313: ## 12. Definition of done
314: 
315: - [ ] Landing page renders with devlog aesthetic.
316: - [ ] Login with GitHub lands on `/repos`.
317: - [ ] Demo repo ingest returns 3 sessions with FQ scores.
318: - [ ] Analyze produces Monaco diff + cluster mentioning barrel exports.
319: - [ ] Open PR creates a real PR on GitHub with reasoning body.
320: - [ ] Parser Vitest suite green.
321: - [ ] Manual checklist A–I walked with no P0 red.

Here's where we are:

## Project: **Reflex.md** — v1 execution

A tool that connects to GitHub, reads coding session transcripts from `entire/checkpoints/v1`, detects repeated corrections (friction patterns), and opens PRs against `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` with improved rules.

## Stack
- **Backend** (`web/backend`): Node 20 + TS + Express + Prisma + Postgres, Gemini via `@google/genai`, GitHub OAuth
- **Frontend** (`web/frontend`): Vite + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, Monaco DiffEditor
- **Deploy**: docker-compose (frontend :3000, backend :3001, Postgres :5432), plus a prod compose + nginx/Dockerfiles

## Where we are per the plan
Based on `web/PLAN_V1.md` + recent commits, the full pipeline is scaffolded:
1. ✅ Scaffold + docker + Prisma schema (User/Repo/Session/Analysis)
2. ✅ Parser aligned to real `entire-cli` + OpenCode transcript formats (`cd18edc`, `13b1544`)
3. ✅ OAuth, `/api/me`, `/api/repos`
4. ✅ Ingest endpoint
5. ✅ Session detail + event drawer + repo search (`1cbdadf`)
6. ✅ Docker + nginx prod scaffolding (`ecd114e`)
7. 🟡 Most recent commit is production config polish (`7fb253a`)

## Recent trajectory
The last few commits look like you've been stabilizing — real-format parser fixes, prod deploy config, UI/schema polish. The core "friction detect → Gemini analyze → open PR" loop should be wired.
